action_request.notes: Runtime payloads may carry contract_version. Strict governed calls require explicit version carriage.

gate_decision.notes: Per-pack decision contract retained for bounded interchange.

runtime_evaluation_result.notes: Legacy/common multi-pack result family retained for M1-compatible evaluation.

requirement_pack.notes: Runtime payloads may carry contract_version. Governance eligibility remains a separate gate.

requirement_pack_governance.notes: 1.1.0 adds optional contract_version carriage; strict governed bindings require it.

governed_pack_binding.notes: Binds one versioned Requirement Pack to one versioned governance record for governed admission.

governed_evaluation_request.notes: 1.1.0 adds optional bounded transport-provenance carriage while preserving strict governed admission.

governed_evaluation_result.notes: 1.2.0 preserves optional bounded transport provenance through the responsibility handoff; provenance remains a transport observation, not trust evidence.
